Iter 21 DM regression (23/23) still passes. Frontend verified via Playwright: /dashboard/disputes renders 'My Disputes' header + ALL/FILED BY ME/ABOUT ME filter chips + empty-state 'No disputes here.' (then list with OPEN pill once dispute created). /dashboard/disputes/{id} renders title, OPEN status pill, FILED BY/ABOUT/ASSIGNED TO boxes (Sam Rivera, Elena Hartwell, Unassigned), Description card, Timeline with 'FILED' event entry. /admin/ombudsman shows 3 stat cards (OPEN DISPUTES=1, UNDER REVIEW=0, FLAGGED DM THREADS=1), Disputes list with Review link, Flagged DM threads list (incl. iter21 flagged thread with reason 'TEST_iter21 ombudsman please review' + 3 MSGS). /admin/disputes/{id} renders dispute detail PLUS 'Ombudsman actions' card: Assign-to-ombudsman select, Move status dropdown (Under review) + Update btn, Resolve/Dismiss section with Outcome select (Dismissed/Upheld/Partial), Financial credit $ input, Resolution rationale textarea (≥10 chars), Finalize btn. Messages thread header shows 'DISPUTE' icon button — clicking it opens FileDisputeModal pre-filled with thread_id ('This dispute is linked to the current conversation. The ombudsman can review the thread on flag.') and recipient (Elena Hartwell), category select, title input, description textarea, File dispute / Cancel buttons. User menu contains 'My Disputes' link. No critical bugs found.

action_items: (Optional) Verify the 'Something wrong? File a dispute' link renders on an actual non-sample partner profile slug (couldn't reach /partners/birthright-hub — returned 404 in test seed).
critical_code_review_comments: disputes.py file_dispute does NOT enforce that against_user_id can't be filer's own id at the DB level (only Python-level check); fine for now since the only entry is this endpoint.
disputes.py _enrich_dispute joins users individually; for queue listings with many disputes (200 cap) it issues O(1) bulk find — acceptable. Good.

disputes.py admin_assign and admin_update_status correctly block re-assign/state-change once status is resolved/dismissed (admin_assign explicitly; admin_update_status implicitly because the status enum forbids re-entering terminal states from a terminal source — but note: an under_review→under_review no-op is technically allowed and will push a status_change event with from==to. Low priority; consider a guard to ignore no-op transitions to keep audit trail clean.)
disputes.py admin_resolve sets resolution.financial_credit_usd from data.financial_credit_usd directly — Pydantic ge=0 enforces non-negative. Good. Step-10 hand-off ready.
disputes.py ombudsman_queue: for non-admin ombudsman, dispute_q['$or'] is set to [assigned_to=me, unassigned]; ombudsman cannot see disputes assigned to OTHER ombudsmen — matches spec.
disputes.py: log_action audit entries written for file/assign/status/resolve — good.
FileDisputeModal correctly pre-fills thread_id (verified visually 'This dispute is linked to the current conversation').
Routes /admin/disputes/{id} (adminMode=true) and /dashboard/disputes/{id} both reuse DisputeDetail.jsx — confirmed by URL inspection. Ombudsman actions card renders only in admin mode. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (My Disputes list+empty state+chips, Dispute detail, Ombudsman queue + 3 stat cards + flagged thread, Admin dispute detail + Ombudsman actions card, FileDisputeModal pre-filled from thread, user-menu 'My Disputes' link all verified)
